name: Hanesaki Mio
source:
Mio is a new heroine who was added to the PlayStation 3 version of the game. Although she is in the same class as [url=/c15061]Takaaki[/url], she often remains unnoticed by other students to the extent that her name is unknown to most of them. [spoiler]She originally ties her hair up and wears eyeglasses, but later wears contact lens and her hair untied as an attempt by Takaaki to change the impression she gives to others.[/spoiler]

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_To_Heart_series_characters#To_Heart_2]Wikipedia[/url]]
